verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party Drive AI surface for asking questions of files, summarizing, or extracting content. The ADK/Vertex AI add-on doc is a developer building block for constructing an agent, not a shipped capability. OCR-for-search is an adjacent feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced
